act_title: The Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation Act, 1961
title: General Fund
text:
24. General Fund.—All receipts of the Corporation other than those referred to in sub-section (1) of

section 23 [or in sub-section (1) of section 23A] shall be credited to the General Fund and all payments
by the Corporation other than those referred to in sub-section (2) [of section 23, or, as the case may be,
sub-section (2) of section 23A] shall be made out of that Fund.
